Ask about my work history, research, data engineering projects or skills.
The assistant retrieves from a curated knowledge base of my CV, publications
and project documentation, routes each question to the right collection and
answers with citations from the retrieved material.

::: {.callout-note title="If the box below looks empty, just wait a moment"}

## How it works

Questions are classified into one of three routes (work history, my own
research, or the related literature), each backed by its own vector
collection. Retrieved chunks are shown alongside every answer — tick "Show
retrieved chunks" to see the passages it read and which route it took. The
pipeline is Python, ChromaDB and Claude, deployed on Google Cloud Run.
